failureMessage: nobody watches a scheduled run — a red run in the Actions list reaches no one

checkEachFile.what: runs on a schedule but has no visible failure escalation (no failure() job, no report-failure call)
checkEachFile.fix: add a job that runs on failure() and opens a workflow-failure tracking issue a human will see (or use the shared report-failure action)

failureMessage: --add-label fails when the label does not exist yet — GitHub will not create it on demand

checkEachFile.what: uses --add-label with no idempotent `gh label create … || true` beforehand
checkEachFile.fix: create the label idempotently before adding it, so the workflow survives its first run

failureMessage: a date-keyed branch collides with itself on a repeat run for the same key

matchLines.what: creates a branch keyed only by the date
matchLines.fix: append a per-run-unique suffix ($RANDOM, github.run_id) to the branch name

failureMessage: upload-pages-artifact tars with --dereference and fails on the dangling .claude/skills/* symlinks, blocking every deploy

checkEachFile.what: uploads the repo root (path: .) to actions/upload-pages-artifact with no step pruning .claude/ — its skills/* symlinks dangle in CI and the tar fails
checkEachFile.fix: add a step before the upload that prunes the agent tooling: `run: rm -rf .claude .claudinite` (never part of a published site)

failureMessage: a second cron competes with the one schedule the repo is meant to have — the per-repo scheduler, which owns every recurring Claudinite job

checkEachFile.what: carries a `schedule:` trigger, but the vendored claudinite-scheduler.yml is this repo's only permitted cron
checkEachFile.fix: port this workflow's steps into the scheduler task that owns the work and delete the workflow in the same commit (per-project-scheduling §3)

checkEachFile.what: a Claudinite executor (it calls a canon reusable workflow) carries a `schedule:` trigger
checkEachFile.fix: remove the schedule: trigger — make it workflow_dispatch only, and adopt the vendored claudinite-scheduler.yml, which owns every recurring Claudinite job (packs/core/scheduled-tasks.md)
